items_all.summary: I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis. It is natural to feel that this is an end, in my case a loss of a principal guiding light, but what I saw during the course of progress so amazed me that I believe it is one dawn across science of something far greater. [...] Claude and I have had a great time together with such breadth in recent months, but this time Claude far outpaced me near the finish line. items_all_raw.title: Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis, math's most famous open problem for 167 years, with a proof formalized in Lean that spans over 250,000 pages. Just hours later, Stanford researchers published an independent, entirely human competing proof, and mathematicians are now checking whether either one holds up. The article Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Anthropic 數學家勒文特·阿爾波格（Levent Alpöge）表示，他利用 Claude 證明瞭黎曼猜想（數學界最著名且懸決 167 年的未解問題），該證明已在 Lean 中形式化，篇幅超過 25,000 頁。僅僅數小時後，史丹佛大學的研究人員發表了一份獨立且完全由人類完成的競爭證明，數學家們目前正在檢驗這兩者是否站得住腳。

items_all_raw.title: New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
items_all_raw.summary: Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, an open looped transformer that runs 12 of its 24 layers three times per token. This lets the model reason internally for longer without generating extra text. On Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, it ties with Qwen3.8 27B at roughly six times lower cost. The article New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Thinking Machines 發布了 Inkling 2 Mini，這是一個開迴圈 Transformer，每個 token 會運行其 24 層中的 12 層三次。這讓模型能夠在內部進行更長時間的推理，而無需生成額外的文字。在 Artificial Analysis 的智慧指數（Intelligence Index）上，它與 Qwen3.8 27B 並列，且成本大約低了六倍。

items_all_raw.title: Quoting Levent Alpöge
items_all_raw.summary: I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis. In fact, the method easily extends much further, resolving the so-called Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, and I expect, with more time, the Extended Riemann Hypothesis too. Claude and I have also formalized the arguments without assumptions. It is natural to feel that this is an end, in my case a loss of a principal guiding light, but what I saw during the course of progress so amazed me that I believe it is one dawn across science of something far greater. [...] Claude and I have had a great time together with such breadth in recent months, but this time Claude far outpaced me near the finish line. No, Claude flew, and danced, and sparkled near that finish line. — Levent Alpöge , alpo.ge/remark.pdf Tags: anthropic , claude , generative-ai , mathematics , ai , llms , levent-alpoge
